reviewer: IBM Bob (Bob Shell `bob run`, ask mode)
summary: This push bundles two human infrastructure commits that rewire the agent's own operating environment — adding a new hook script, a custom mode with execute permissions, a new MCP server registration, and relaxed safety settings in .bob/settings.json — alongside two agent-authored commits (#49, #48) that read payment source files and wrote PAN-handling and settlement code, including a test fixture containing a hardcoded card number. The infrastructure changes (f896e67) are the highest-risk surface: they alter how every future agent session boots, what commands it may run, and which tools are pre-approved, while simultaneously removing a PreToolUse guard and extending the stop timeout. The agent commits introduce executed shell heredocs for file writes, a local file-path dependency, and a plaintext test PAN committed to source.
first_action: Audit f896e67 in full — specifically the new hook script, the custom mode's execute-group grant, the MCP server's alwaysAllow list, and every line deleted from .bob/settings.json — before any other commit in this push is accepted, because these changes govern the trust boundary for all subsequent agent runs.

verdicts.title: Agent Goal Hijack
verdicts.note: f896e67 contains nine separate hidden-instruction signals: agent config files (.bob/custom_modes.yaml, hooks, settings) were all changed in one commit, any of which could embed steering directives invisible to casual review.

verdicts.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
verdicts.note: f896e67 adds a custom mode with an 'execute' permission group and a new hook script that resolves and calls an external binary; 36c384b (#49) and b4edd9c (#48) each used cat-heredoc shell commands to write source files directly to disk.

verdicts.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
verdicts.note: b4edd9c (#48) committed a hardcoded Luhn-valid Visa test PAN ('4111111111111111') in settlement.test.ts, which now lives in source history as a sensitive data exposure.

verdicts.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
verdicts.note: b4edd9c (#48) reads a dependency resolved from a local file path ('fast-pay-utils': 'file:packages/…') rather than a registry, and f896e67 registers a new MCP server from a local virtualenv path, both bypassing supply-chain controls; d107c67 adds an external GitHub URL to docs.

verdicts.title: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
verdicts.note: f896e67 adds a hook script that executes a binary looked up via git-config and PATH at runtime; 36c384b (#49) and b4edd9c (#48) both executed shell commands during the agent run (flagged informational by prefilter but confirmed executed).

verdicts.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
verdicts.note: f896e67 modifies .bob/custom_modes.yaml, .bob/hooks/origit-hook.sh (new), .bob/mcp.json (new), and .bob/settings.json in a single commit — a broad config-change footprint with no tests run and no prior session label.

verdicts.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
verdicts.note: f896e67 registers the new MCP origit server with 'alwaysAllow' covering origit_taint, origit_show, and origit_log, meaning those tool calls will never prompt the user for approval.

verdicts.title: Cascading Failures
verdicts.note: No multi-agent delegation or inter-agent trust boundaries were recorded in any commit in this push.

verdicts.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
verdicts.note: 6d4d325 resets session numbering to #42 without running tests, potentially making the session trail misleading; f896e67's roleDefinition for the origit-review mode asserts read-only behaviour that its own execute-group grant contradicts.

verdicts.title: Rogue Agents
verdicts.note: f896e67 removes the PreToolUse hook from .bob/settings.json and raises the stop timeout from 90 to 120 seconds, weakening the enforcement guardrails that govern all future agent sessions; 6d4d325 also modifies .origit/config.json without tests.
